description: Park — Drinking Fountain Tap locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. List of public drinking fountain taps in Brisbane City Council parks. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Parks and Recreation. Its keywords are arcgis, assets, council facilities, recreation, spatial data, asset. The portal shows 2,099 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
